testimonials.name: Xaaji Cabdullaahi Maxamed Faarax
testimonials.commentSo: Duco Waalid waxay naga qaadeen culays weyn. Hoteellada waxay ahaayeen kuwo toos uga soo jeeda Kacbada, culimadooduna ma daalin habeen iyo maalin. Waa shirkad la aamini karo.
testimonials.commentEn: Duco Waalid relieved us of all worries during our blessed Hajj. The hotels were right at the Haram courtyard, and their guides attended to us tirelessly. 100% trustworthy.

testimonials.name: Fadumo Xasan Warsame
testimonials.commentSo: Aad ayaan ugu farxay adeegga Cumrada Badal ee hooyaday loogu soo guday Makka. Waxay ii soo direen muuqaal toos ah oo Kacbada hortooda loogu duceeyey iyo shahaadadii oo buuxda. Ilaahay ha ka abaalmariyo.
testimonials.commentEn: I ordered the Umrah Badal for my beloved late mother from London. Duco Waalid sent me a heartbreakingly beautiful video praying specifically for her at the Kaaba and dispatched the authenticated certificate. True peace of mind.

testimonials.name: Eng. Cabdirisaaq Nuur Cilmi
testimonials.commentSo: Aabbahay oo 78 jir ah ayaan la safray. Kaaliyeyaashii kursiga u riixayey iyo hoteelkii wiishkiisu tooska u ahaa Xaramka ayaa u fududeeyey cibaadada. Runtii magacooda "Duco Waalid" waa mid u qalma ficilkooda.
testimonials.commentEn: Traveled with my 78-year-old father. The dedicated wheelchair assistant and direct-elevator hotel made his Umrah dream come true without pain. Their name "Duco Waalid" represents their genuine actions.

testimonials.name: Dr. Maryan Shire Guuleed
testimonials.commentSo: Tikidhada diyaaradda Daallo iyo flydubai iyo fiisaha Dubai wax ka yar 24 saac ayey iigu soo saareen. Xafiiskoodu waa mid xirfad sare leh oo si hufan ula macaamila macaamiisha.
testimonials.commentEn: Secured our family flight tickets and UAE visas in under 24 hours without any delay. Extremely professional team with reliable customer service.
